def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # Validate input matrices
    for name, arr in [("logp_with_result", logp_with_result),
                      ("logp_call_only", logp_call_only),
                      ("logp_no_call", logp_no_call)]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray) or arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D numpy array")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must contain only finite values")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must contain only nonpositive values")

    shape = logp_with_result.shape
    if logp_call_only.shape != shape or logp_no_call.shape != shape:
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")

    # Validate tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not np.isscalar(tau_filter) or not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative number")

    # Compute per-candidate margins and keep mask
    avg_with = np.mean(logp_with_result, axis=1)
    avg_call = np.mean(logp_call_only, axis=1)
    avg_no = np.mean(logp_no_call, axis=1)
    margin = avg_with - np.maximum(avg_call, avg_no)
    keep = margin > tau_filter

    return keep, margin
